entities.summary: Romildo Jorge Etcheverry was a Paraguayan footballer that played either as a midfielder or defender. Etcheverry was part of the Paraguay national football team that participated in the 1930 FIFA World Cup. During most of his career he played for Club Rubio Ñu, Olimpia Asunción and later was transferred to Boca Juniors where he won the 1934 Argentine first division.
